interface.longDescription:
Prompt Optimizer is an AI prompt optimizer and prompt improver for Codex and ChatGPT. Paste a rough draft, ask for it to be improved, and get back one clearer, better-structured prompt, ready to send. It never runs the task in your draft.

What it does
- Prompt optimization: turns a rough draft into a clear request with the goal, the constraints and the output form stated.
- Improve prompts for ChatGPT, Codex or any other AI assistant you write for.
- Keeps your names, numbers, dates, code and quoted text exactly as written.
- Replies in the language of your draft.
- Leaves open details open: no invented facts and no placeholders.

How to use it
Ask in plain words:
Improve this prompt before I send it: write a blog post about fitness.
Or name the skill: $prompt-optimizer-new followed by your draft.

Install in Codex
codex plugin marketplace add bitcompool/prompt-optimizer-codex-plugin
Then open /plugins in Codex CLI and install Prompt Optimizer.
Source and updates: https://github.com/bitcompool/prompt-optimizer-codex-plugin

What it does not do
- It does not carry out the task in your draft or answer its question.
- It does not ask clarifying questions first.
- It does not write a prompt from nothing: you bring the draft.
- It does not edit finished text such as an essay or an email.

Skills only: no tools, no accounts, no network calls. Your draft never leaves the conversation.

Also available as a Chrome extension: Prompt Optimizer for AI Chats adds the same rewrite, plus Advisor, inside the AI chats you already use. https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/prompt-optimizer-for-ai-c/gdcbodccfgjcmpgalklepecanaclmkab
